svg.font-family: Segoe UI, Inter, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: Model Hosting Platform — AWS Reference Architecture
Native AWS service icons · single region, multi-AZ · VPC isolation · EKS running KServe, agentgateway, KEDA and Karpenter
3+ replicas across 3 AZs · HPA on RPS · weighted split · authN/Z · per-model quotas · OTel
Model-aware routing · timeouts, retries, circuit breaking · request mirroring for shadow tests
Managed control plane · EKS Pod Identity · one namespace per owning team
KServe InferenceServices — one workload per (model, version)
Karpenter NodePools — instance-type flexible, AZ spread
Weights pulled over VPC endpoints — no NAT egress
Images signed with cosign, verified by Kyverno
No state in inference pods — Git, S3 and ECR only
One namespace per owning team · default-deny policy
Model containers stay black boxes behind a published contract — the platform owns routing, scaling, isolation and observability; the ML team owns what runs inside the image.
